newsitem.title: UK: Rexam seals major medical supply contract.
newsitem.headline: Rexam seals major medical supply contract.

text.p: Fast-restructuring British packaging and papers group Rexam Plc said on Monday it had signed a seven-year supply deal with Allegiance Healthcare Corp of the U.S., worth about $280 million.

In a statement Rexam called the agreement "the largest contract ever awarded for medical packaging", noting that its healthcare packaging is the leading player in the global medical device and pharmaceutical packaging market with sales of about 180 million stg.
It added that the deal provided the opportunity for Rexam to increase further its sales volume to Allegiance.
